The remake of ”Hug” is also a hot topic Three songs by boy group RIIZE made it into the 2024 Melon annual chart, marking a "top tier" moment. According to the 2024 Melon Annual Chart announced on the 9th, "RIIZE" ranked 25th in "Love 119" and 10th in "Get A In particular, the debut song "Get A Guitar" released in September 2023 was "Guitar" successfully made it onto the Melon monthly charts for 15 consecutive months from the time of its release until November 2024, and has been loved by listeners for a long time, even beyond the year. In addition, the single "Love 119" released in January 2024 will also be on the MelOn monthly chart for 12 consecutive months, and will be on the charts again this winter. The group is showing a rapid rise in the charts and continues to enjoy long-running popularity. The title song of their first mini album, "Boom Boom," released in June 2024, "Riize" has once again proven its presence as a "next generation music powerhouse" with "Riize's new single "Bass" making it onto the Melon annual charts. Meanwhile, RIIZE will release a remake of TVXQ's "Hug" on January 8th ahead of the release of their SM Entertainment 30th anniversary album this year. The release preview of the song has been met with a passionate response. "RIIZE" will be appearing on "SMTOWN LIVE 2025" on the 11th and 12th, and on Mnet's "M They will perform the song "Hug" on the stage of "COUNTDOWN".
